stations.title: Forecast service
stations.note: And the page waits with it.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: One hang holds up the page

captions: Waiting is tidy now. Next, Odile wants one status page with the forecast on it.
The forecast service sometimes hangs, and the whole page waits with it.
You write the code that runs calls at once and gives up in time, in three tasks.
Now the page loads in one go, and a slow forecast is dropped after half a second.
Everything at once, and nothing waits forever.
